scope: RESEARCH_ONLY; not connected to public allocator or registered actual event
quantity: continuous pro-rata research, separately from whole-account fractional rights
execution: first verified rights trading-session close after known listing; official exact security and observed execution price required
settlement: explicit observed settlement basis/date; proceeds are receivable until then
pending_valuation: explicit as-of evidence-backed rights marks required every session; no default intrinsic/zero value
unavailable_input: BLOCK_NAV; never infer quote, settlement day, fractional cash or subscribe using future issue price
alternative: funded_subscription is a different predeclared policy requiring as-of confirmed price, actual payment and tradability; no automatic switch
